answer: Each agent binds its identity to a hardware-enforced zero-trust attestation root, so a sybil must physically replicate a sovereign root as lone willow cloning itself across a lagoon. Fault-injection-hardened lattice polynomial ring accelerators sign every attestation, letting peers verify membership in the trusted grove without centralized registries. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
